content: {"praised":["Deeply moving and spiritually inspirational portrayal of Jesus' life.","Accurate depiction of Jewish context and Roman occupation.","Stunning visual quality and clear sound.","Strong, full soundtrack enhances emotional impact.","Clear, vibrant picture makes scenes vivid."],"criticized":["Leaves out most important moments of Jesus' life.","Focuses too much on Roman occupation, not Jesus.","Jesus barely appears until the Jordan scene.","Inaccurate portrayal of Jesus' ethnicity and appearance.","Fails to show Jesus as divine figure."]}
